name: A CAPITAL B
note: EXTRACTED from docs/121-the-not-done-list.md (THE LINES) by tools/extract-content.mjs (errata 250). Do not edit: change doc 121 and re-run. A worn sort from the Clarion's type case. Laid on his own coffin.

LOOK_AT.say: A capital B, in lead, cast backward and worn nearly flat. It has been in every edition I have.
repeat: Backward, it looks like nothing at all. That is the whole secret of the trade.
Lead. It is the weightiest remark the Clarion has made about me.

LISTEN_TO.say: Nothing. It has been pressed into my name so often it has no more to say.
repeat: A dull click against the tuning fork. Lead does not ring. It was never meant to.
Nothing. One letter is not yet an opinion.
